title: Gemini Robotics 2 Brings Google's AI Into the Physical World
summary: Google DeepMind just released a new version of its artificial intelligence model Gemini , and it can control a range of different robots—including humanoids capable of dextrous tasks like screwing in lightbulbs and tying trash bags.
